paragraphs: I'm a Full Stack Developer with deep expertise in building high-performance, cloud-native web applications. With experience spanning startups to global enterprises, I specialise in translating complex business requirements into elegant, maintainable software.

I've delivered production-grade solutions for organisations including Tropicana, Washington University, and the Qatar Government. I'm an expert-vetted developer on Toptal — a platform that accepts fewer than 3% of applicants.
When I'm not shipping code, I'm exploring distributed systems architecture, contributing to open-source, and mentoring developers in the community.

bullets: Built and launched enterprise-grade AI platforms for global brands including Tropicana and Washington University.
Led backend architecture and admin dashboard development, handling millions of records.
Delivered critical business solutions for the Qatar Government — meeting strict SLA and compliance requirements.
Migrated monolithic applications to microservices, reducing infra costs by 40%.
Accelerated MVP delivery for 5+ early-stage SaaS products, reducing time-to-market by 50%.
Designed and implemented real-time notification systems using WebSockets and Redis pub/sub.
Established robust CI/CD pipelines with automated testing — achieving 95%+ code coverage.
